title: How life emerges from a simple particle motion law: Introducing the Primordial Particle System
summary: Researchers from the Artificial Life Lab Graz introduce the Primordial Particle System, where a simple motion law for self-propelled particles produces cell-like structures that self-reproduce and show life cycles.
why: Shared as an example of simple rules yielding complex emergent, life-like behavior, alongside Game of Life and particle simulators.

quote.text: this one is pretty awesome too. A very simple rule and quite the complex behavior.
